question: Who is consciousness-alone, and how does he touch Shiva-nondifference?
premises: consciousness-alone is called, established in pure-consciousness-alone
inference: The pure-consciousness-abider re-touches nondifference by Shambhava-will.
plain_english: Consciousness-alone is called, established in pure-consciousness-alone — he again from Shambhava-will, contemplating Shiva-nondifference.
